geography: United States with global manufacturing, health, policy, and seaweed evidence
scope_note: Major U.S. commodity resins plus important engineering polymers, additives, particles, alternatives, and seaweed-derived films. This is not a claim that every commercial formulation has been characterized.
research_method_note: The Firecrawl deep-research workflow determined the evidence architecture. Firecrawl retrieval returned HTTP 402 because project credits were unavailable, so evidence was obtained directly from official agencies, federal laboratories, publisher records, full-text peer-reviewed papers, and source PDFs. Figure-only water values were inspected with the PDF workflow and are labeled approximate_from_figure.
